descriptions.value: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.42 does not verify a CSRF nonce on its Empty Trash media action, so a forged cross-site request can cause a logged-in user with the Editor role or above to permanently delete every trashed attachment on the site.

assertions.title: Media Library Assistant < 3.42 - Trashed Attachment Deletion via CSRF

title: Media Library Assistant < 3.42 - Trashed Attachment Deletion via CSRF

descriptions.value: The Smart Popup by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 2.0.2 does not prevent template-injection payloads from being stored in a popup text block and later evaluated by its template engine, because the filter meant to strip template delimiters runs before a decoding step that reconstructs them, allowing an authenticated administrator to execute arbitrary template expressions server-side and read PHP constants such as the site's database credentials and authentication keys.

descriptions.description: CWE-1336 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

assertions.title: Smart Popup by Supsystic < 2.0.2 - Admin+ SSTI via Popup Text Block
